name: Skills First subsidised training and concession fees (Victoria)
summary: Government-subsidised TAFE and training places in Victoria, with lower concession fees for Health Care Card holders at Certificate IV and below.
who: Australian citizens, permanent residents or New Zealand citizens
Physically present in Victoria or a designated border region while training
Concession: Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card or Veteran's Gold Card holders, or their dependent spouse or child
how: Contact your preferred training provider to confirm eligibility and whether a Skills First place is available
catches: Concessions only for Certificate IV and below, and skill sets
Limit of 2 courses at a time and 2 in a year

source.label: Victorian Government: How to check your eligibility (Skills First)

evidence.quote: Concessions are available for Certificate IV level and below courses, and skill sets.
You can also get a concession if you are a dependent spouse or a dependent child of a card holder.
Contact your preferred training provider to find out if you're eligible for Skills First
